newsitem.title: FINLAND: UPM eyes NYSE listing, share buy-back -FT.
newsitem.headline: UPM eyes NYSE listing, share buy-back -FT.

text.p: Finnish forest industry group UPM-Kymmene Oy is considering a New York listing as part of a strategy to raise its profile in North America, Financial Times reported on Thursday.
"It is a possibility ... we want to be in the world's biggest capital markets and we must be known there," Financial Times quoted UPM-Kymmene CEO Juha Niemela as saying in an interview.
No decision had been taken and there was yet no timetable for the listing, the paper said.
In September, UPM said it had launched a programme to trade American Depositary Receipts in its shares on U.S. OTC markets.
Financial Times said UPM is also considering an option to buy back own shares to improve shareholder value.
"UPM-Kymmene would be studying the outcome of Finnish government plans to make share repurchases more advantageous for companies," the paper said.
